summary: Manage Excel Links sizes its columns to what they contain when it opens, and a value too long for its column now wraps onto a second line instead of being cut off.
details: Each column has its own width cap, so a deep folder path can no longer push the Workbook and Dataset Name columns off screen.
A wrapped cell is held to two lines, keeping the tallest row inside twice the normal row height.
Dragging a column edge still pins that column to the width you gave it; double-clicking the edge hands it back to automatic sizing.
